answer:
The motto of the Olympics that had Fuwa as the mascots was **"One World, One Dream"** (同一个世界，同一个梦想 in Chinese).

The **Fuwa** (欢欢、迎迎、妮妮、晶晶、贝贝 - Huanhuan, Yingying, Nini, Jingjing, and Beibei) were the five official mascots of the **2008 Summer Olympics held in Beijing**. Together, their names spell out "Beijing Welcomes You" (Bei Jing Huan Ying Ni in pinyin), which served as an unofficial greeting slogan while "One World, One Dream" was the official Olympic theme/motto for those Games.
